#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reviewed two-phase installer for the authorized mVllm_2 Linux GPU environment.
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077

readonly REPO='/home/liuyang/文档/mVllm_2'
readonly PREFIX='/home/liuyang/miniconda3/envs/mvllm2'
readonly CONDA='/home/liuyang/miniconda3/bin/conda'
readonly UV_SOURCE='/home/liuyang/文档/mVllm_2-migration-7eeb93a7/deployment-tools-20260914/bin/uv'
readonly EXPECTED_HEAD='3f200461026a59676aaac7ea864f8fadb599688d'
readonly EXPECTED_SUBMODULE='4447137e08c172d7701594b4d1695a6d4a869cbd'
readonly EXPECTED_LOCK_SHA='caf298c41681cfabe1fdaae707b0a4890e4e077a5d98b86ae18b658d7227416d'
readonly EXPECTED_VALIDATOR_SHA='b2caaa72a6762ce9f1b2fae13d6dab9b98d421f8d213f93d282a177d6d83fde6'
readonly EXPECTED_UV_SHA='2856d1bf7e5bcfba7df20ae6f939340ae1f8022d2d103cada1a6da597df86e32'
readonly EXPECTED_UV_VERSION='uv 0.11.21 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)'
readonly RUN_ROOT='/home/liuyang/mvllm2-conda-setup-20261013'
readonly UV_INDEX='https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple'
readonly CONDA_CHANNEL='https://conda.anaconda.org/conda-forge'
readonly SYSTEM_PATH='/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin'

# Remove inherited package, Python, environment, cache, and Git overrides. Keep real HOME untouched.
while IFS='=' read -r name _; do
  case "$name" in
    UV_*|PIP_*|PYTHON*|VIRTUAL_ENV|CONDA*|GIT_*|XDG_CACHE_HOME|MPLCONFIGDIR|TMPDIR|TMP|TEMP|HF_*|TRANSFORMERS_*|TORCH_HOME|CUDA_CACHE_PATH|JOBLIB_TEMP_FOLDER|JUPYTER_*) unset "$name" || true ;;
  esac
done < <(env)
export GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
# Highest-priority Git config also disables repo-local fsmonitor and hooks.
export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2
export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=core.fsmonitor
export GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false
export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.hooksPath
export GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=/dev/null
export PATH="$(dirname "$CONDA"):$SYSTEM_PATH"

if [[ -e "$RUN_ROOT" || -L "$RUN_ROOT" ]]; then
  echo "STOP: run directory already exists: $RUN_ROOT" >&2
  exit 20
fi
mkdir -m 700 "$RUN_ROOT"
mkdir -m 700 "$RUN_ROOT/cache" "$RUN_ROOT/logs"
readonly LOG="$RUN_ROOT/logs/install.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$LOG") 2>&1
export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$RUN_ROOT/cache/xdg"
export MPLCONFIGDIR="$RUN_ROOT/cache/matplotlib"
export TMPDIR="$RUN_ROOT/cache/tmp"
export HF_HOME="$RUN_ROOT/cache/huggingface"
export TORCH_HOME="$RUN_ROOT/cache/torch"
export CUDA_CACHE_PATH="$RUN_ROOT/cache/cuda"
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export MPLBACKEND=Agg
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
mkdir -m 700 "$XDG_CACHE_HOME" "$MPLCONFIGDIR" "$TMPDIR" "$HF_HOME" "$TORCH_HOME" "$CUDA_CACHE_PATH"

write_summary() {
  local input="$1" output="$2"
  { printf 'count='; wc -l < "$input"; sha256sum < "$input"; } > "$output"
}

snapshot_old_env() {
  local label="$1" env_name="$2" p="/home/liuyang/miniconda3/envs/$2"
  "$p/bin/python" -I -B - "$label" "$env_name" "$p" "$RUN_ROOT/logs" <<'PY'
import importlib.metadata as md, json, pathlib, sys
label, name, prefix, outdir = sys.argv[1:]
dists=[]
for d in md.distributions():
    raw=d.read_text('direct_url.json')
    try:
        direct=json.loads(raw) if raw else None
    except Exception:
        direct={'unparsed':raw}
    dists.append({'name':d.metadata.get('Name'),'version':d.version,'direct_url':direct})
dists.sort(key=lambda x:((x['name'] or '').lower(),x['version']))
obj={'prefix':prefix,'python':sys.version.split()[0],'distributions':dists}
path=pathlib.Path(outdir)/f'old-{name}-{label}.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
print(f'OLD_ENV_{label}_{name}_DISTRIBUTIONS={len(dists)}')
PY
  find "$p/conda-meta" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %s %T@\n' 2>/dev/null | sort > "$RUN_ROOT/logs/old-$env_name-$label-conda-meta.txt"
  {
    write_summary "$RUN_ROOT/logs/old-$env_name-$label-conda-meta.txt" "$RUN_ROOT/logs/old-$env_name-$label-conda-meta-summary.txt"
    find "$p/lib/python3.11" \( -type d -name __pycache__ -o -type f -name '*.pyc' \) -printf '%y %p %s %T@\n' 2>/dev/null | sort > "$RUN_ROOT/logs/old-$env_name-$label-pycache.txt"
    write_summary "$RUN_ROOT/logs/old-$env_name-$label-pycache.txt" "$RUN_ROOT/logs/old-$env_name-$label-pycache-summary.txt"
  }
}

repo_status() {
  local target="$1"
  local main sub
  main="$(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git -C "$REPO" --no-optional-locks status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
  sub="$(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git -C "$REPO/LlamaFactory" --no-optional-locks status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
  printf '%s\n' "$main" > "$RUN_ROOT/logs/repo-main-$target.status"
  printf '%s\n' "$sub" > "$RUN_ROOT/logs/repo-submodule-$target.status"
  [[ -z "$main" && -z "$sub" ]] || { echo "STOP: tracked/untracked changes in formal repo or submodule ($target)"; return 1; }
  echo "REPO_AND_SUBMODULE_CLEAN_$target=yes"
}

repo_pycache_snapshot() {
  local label="$1"
  find "$REPO" \
    -path "$REPO/.git" -prune -o -path "$REPO/LlamaFactory/.git" -prune -o \
    -path "$REPO/data" -prune -o -path "$REPO/store" -prune -o -path "$REPO/outputs" -prune -o \
    -path "$REPO/runs" -prune -o -path "$REPO/.venv" -prune -o -path '*/node_modules' -prune -o \
    \( -type d -name __pycache__ -o -type f -name '*.pyc' \) -printf '%y %p %s %T@\n' | sort > "$RUN_ROOT/logs/repo-pycache-$label.txt"
  write_summary "$RUN_ROOT/logs/repo-pycache-$label.txt" "$RUN_ROOT/logs/repo-pycache-$label-summary.txt"
}

[[ -x "$CONDA" && -x "$UV_SOURCE" ]] || { echo 'STOP: explicit Conda or reviewed uv binary is unavailable'; exit 21; }
[[ "$(sha256sum "$UV_SOURCE" | cut -d' ' -f1)" == "$EXPECTED_UV_SHA" ]] || { echo 'STOP: uv binary SHA differs from reviewed binary'; exit 21; }
[[ "$("$UV_SOURCE" --version)" == "$EXPECTED_UV_VERSION" ]] || { echo 'STOP: uv binary version differs from reviewed version'; exit 21; }
[[ -e "$REPO/.git" && "$(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git -C "$REPO/LlamaFactory" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --show-toplevel)" == "$REPO/LlamaFactory" ]] || { echo 'STOP: expected formal checkout/submodule missing'; exit 22; }
[[ ! -e "$PREFIX" && ! -L "$PREFIX" ]] || { echo "STOP: prefix already exists; do not overwrite: $PREFIX"; exit 23; }
[[ "$(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git -C "$REPO" --no-optional-locks rev-parse HEAD)" == "$EXPECTED_HEAD" ]] || { echo 'STOP: formal checkout HEAD changed'; exit 24; }
[[ "$(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git -C "$REPO/LlamaFactory" --no-optional-locks rev-parse HEAD)" == "$EXPECTED_SUBMODULE" ]] || { echo 'STOP: submodule HEAD changed'; exit 25; }
[[ "$(sha256sum "$REPO/requirements-linux-gpu.lock" | cut -d' ' -f1)" == "$EXPECTED_LOCK_SHA" ]] || { echo 'STOP: lockfile changed'; exit 26; }
[[ "$(sha256sum "$REPO/scripts/source_validate_environment.py" | cut -d' ' -f1)" == "$EXPECTED_VALIDATOR_SHA" ]] || { echo 'STOP: validator changed'; exit 27; }
[[ "$(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git -C "$REPO" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current)" == 'main' ]] || { echo 'STOP: formal checkout is not on main'; exit 27; }
repo_status before
repo_pycache_snapshot before

available_kib="$(df -Pk /home/liuyang/miniconda3 | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')"
[[ "$available_kib" -ge 20971520 ]] || { echo 'STOP: less than 20 GiB free on target filesystem'; exit 27; }
for tool in /usr/bin/git /usr/bin/ffmpeg /usr/bin/ffprobe /usr/bin/nvidia-smi; do
  [[ -x "$tool" ]] || { echo "STOP: required system tool unavailable: $tool"; exit 27; }
done
/usr/bin/nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv,noheader

lock_count="$(awk 'NF && $1 !~ /^#/ {n++} END {print n+0}' "$REPO/requirements-linux-gpu.lock")"
[[ "$lock_count" == 242 ]] || { echo "STOP: lock structure changed (expected 241 pinned packages plus editable, saw $lock_count lines)"; exit 28; }
[[ "$("$CONDA" --version)" == 'conda 25.11.1' ]] || { echo 'STOP: Conda version changed since preflight'; exit 29; }

export CONDA_PKGS_DIRS="$RUN_ROOT/cache/conda-pkgs"
export CONDA_ENVS_PATH='/home/liuyang/miniconda3/envs'
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$RUN_ROOT/cache/uv"
export UV_NO_CONFIG=1
export UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never
export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1
export PIP_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null
mkdir -m 700 "$CONDA_PKGS_DIRS" "$UV_CACHE_DIR"

for env_name in agent cpm45; do snapshot_old_env before "$env_name"; done
printf 'PREFLIGHT repo=%s prefix=%s\n' "$REPO" "$PREFIX"
printf 'TOOLS conda=%s uv=%s uv_sha=%s git=%s ffmpeg=%s ffprobe=%s\n' "$($CONDA --version)" "$("$UV_SOURCE" --version)" "$(sha256sum "$UV_SOURCE" | cut -d' ' -f1)" "$(/usr/bin/git --version)" "$(/usr/bin/ffmpeg -version | head -n1)" "$(/usr/bin/ffprobe -version | head -n1)"

# Conda writes the new prefix and its own environment registration; package cache is task-local.
"$CONDA" create --yes --prefix "$PREFIX" --override-channels --channel "$CONDA_CHANNEL" 'python=3.11'
[[ -x "$PREFIX/bin/python" ]] || { echo 'STOP: Conda did not create the expected Python'; exit 30; }
"$PREFIX/bin/python" -I -B -c 'import sys; assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3,11), sys.version; print("NEW_PYTHON",sys.prefix,sys.version.split()[0])'

# Keep doctor operational without depending on a removable deployment-tools checkout.
install -m 0755 "$UV_SOURCE" "$PREFIX/bin/uv"
cmp -s "$UV_SOURCE" "$PREFIX/bin/uv"
[[ "$(sha256sum "$PREFIX/bin/uv" | cut -d' ' -f1)" == "$EXPECTED_UV_SHA" ]] || { echo 'STOP: copied uv binary SHA mismatch'; exit 35; }
printf 'INSTALLED_UV version=%s sha256=%s\n' "$("$PREFIX/bin/uv" --version)" "$(sha256sum "$PREFIX/bin/uv" | cut -d' ' -f1)"

# uv receives only the new interpreter and current lock; editable resolves from formal checkout.
cd "$REPO"
"$PREFIX/bin/uv" --no-config pip sync --python "$PREFIX/bin/python" --default-index "$UV_INDEX" requirements-linux-gpu.lock

# Run the frozen doctor through a wrapper that disables bytecode and propagates -B
# only to its Python child processes; non-Python commands and all other args are unchanged.
readonly DOCTOR_WRAPPER="$RUN_ROOT/doctor_wrapper.py"
cat > "$DOCTOR_WRAPPER" <<'PY'
import os, runpy, subprocess, sys
validator, profile = sys.argv[1:]
original_run = subprocess.run
def run_no_bytecode(args, *positional, **kwargs):
    if isinstance(args, (list, tuple)) and args and os.fspath(args[0]) == sys.executable:
        args = list(args)
        if '-B' not in args[1:]:
            args.insert(1, '-B')
    return original_run(args, *positional, **kwargs)
subprocess.run = run_no_bytecode
sys.argv = [validator, '--profile', profile]
runpy.run_path(validator, run_name='__main__')
PY
PATH="$PREFIX/bin:$SYSTEM_PATH" GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 "$PREFIX/bin/python" -I -B "$DOCTOR_WRAPPER" "$REPO/scripts/source_validate_environment.py" linux-gpu
PATH="$PREFIX/bin:$SYSTEM_PATH" GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 "$PREFIX/bin/uv" --no-config pip check --python "$PREFIX/bin/python"
"$PREFIX/bin/python" -I -B - "$REPO" <<'PY'
import importlib.metadata as md, json, pathlib, sys
repo=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
d=md.distribution('llamafactory')
raw=d.read_text('direct_url.json')
assert raw, 'editable direct_url.json missing'
data=json.loads(raw)
assert data.get('dir_info',{}).get('editable') is True, data
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlparse
source=pathlib.Path(unquote(urlparse(data['url']).path)).resolve()
assert source == (repo/'LlamaFactory').resolve(), (source,repo)
print('EDITABLE_SOURCE',source)
PY

repo_status after
[[ "$(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git -C "$REPO" --no-optional-locks rev-parse HEAD)" == "$EXPECTED_HEAD" ]] || { echo 'STOP: formal checkout HEAD changed during install'; exit 31; }
[[ "$(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git -C "$REPO/LlamaFactory" --no-optional-locks rev-parse HEAD)" == "$EXPECTED_SUBMODULE" ]] || { echo 'STOP: submodule HEAD changed during install'; exit 32; }
[[ "$(sha256sum "$REPO/requirements-linux-gpu.lock" | cut -d' ' -f1)" == "$EXPECTED_LOCK_SHA" ]] || { echo 'STOP: lock changed during install'; exit 33; }
[[ "$(sha256sum "$REPO/scripts/source_validate_environment.py" | cut -d' ' -f1)" == "$EXPECTED_VALIDATOR_SHA" ]] || { echo 'STOP: validator changed during install'; exit 34; }
repo_pycache_snapshot after
for env_name in agent cpm45; do snapshot_old_env after "$env_name"; done
for env_name in agent cpm45; do
  cmp -s "$RUN_ROOT/logs/old-$env_name-before.json" "$RUN_ROOT/logs/old-$env_name-after.json" || { echo "STOP: old $env_name distribution metadata changed"; exit 36; }
  cmp -s "$RUN_ROOT/logs/old-$env_name-before-conda-meta-summary.txt" "$RUN_ROOT/logs/old-$env_name-after-conda-meta-summary.txt" || { echo "STOP: old $env_name conda-meta summary changed"; exit 37; }
  cmp -s "$RUN_ROOT/logs/old-$env_name-before-pycache-summary.txt" "$RUN_ROOT/logs/old-$env_name-after-pycache-summary.txt" || { echo "STOP: old $env_name pycache metadata changed"; exit 37; }
  echo "OLD_ENV_UNCHANGED_$env_name=distribution-json-conda-meta-and-pycache-metadata-summaries"
done
cmp -s "$RUN_ROOT/logs/repo-pycache-before-summary.txt" "$RUN_ROOT/logs/repo-pycache-after-summary.txt" || { echo 'STOP: repository pycache metadata changed'; exit 38; }
for status_file in repo-main repo-submodule; do cmp -s "$RUN_ROOT/logs/$status_file-before.status" "$RUN_ROOT/logs/$status_file-after.status" || { echo "STOP: $status_file status changed"; exit 39; }; done
printf 'COMPLETE prefix=%s run_root=%s\n' "$PREFIX" "$RUN_ROOT"
printf 'SCOPE_WRITES new_prefix,run_logs_and_cache,conda_new_environment_registration,editable_build_metadata_if_project_requires\n'
printf 'NO_MODEL_LOADED training_started=no inference_started=no evaluation_started=no\n'
